title: PixReenact: Pixel-Conditioned Causal Video Diffusion for Streaming Head-Avatar Reenactment
title_zh: PixReenact：基于像素条件因果视频扩散的流式头部虚拟形象重演系统

paragraphs.en: Streaming head-avatar reenactment aims to animate a reference image according to a live driving video, requiring robust motion transfer, long-term identity stability, and low latency. Existing methods often rely on specialized identity or motion representations, which can discard useful visual information and inherit failure modes from external extractors. In addition, many recent diffusion-based reenactment methods use offline, clip-based generation, jointly processing and denoising an entire video clip before producing its output, making continuous low-latency streaming difficult. We introduce PixReenact , a pixel-conditioned streaming reenactment framework built on causal video diffusion. PixReenact conditions directly on VAE-encoded reference and driving frames, without specialized identity or motion representations. To separate reference identity from driver motion, we train with cross-identity pseudo supervision together with corrective objectives anchored to the original reference and driving inputs. Long self-rollouts reduce autoregressive drift, while state-aware dual-teacher distillation separately addresses cold-start and steady-state generation. Across three cross-identity benchmarks and a long-horizon streaming benchmark, PixReenact demonstrates robust cross-identity reenactment, particularly under challenging conditions such as extreme viewpoints, occlusions, and pronounced facial expressions, while maintaining the reference identity over long streams. A 4-NFE rolling student continuously emits four frames per update with a mean emission latency of 239 ms.

paragraphs.en: Many existing head-avatar methods condition generation on specialized identity or motion representations, such as implicit keypoints Guo et al. (2024) ; Li et al. (2026) , 3DMM or pose/expression parameters Chu and Harada (2024) , and learned identity or motion representations Zhao et al. (2025) ; Xu et al. (2025) ; Cheng et al. (2025) . These representations provide effective and controllable conditioning. Moreover, motion representations that suppress appearance reduce identity information carried by the driving signal, supporting cross-identity reenactment. However, they can discard fine-grained visual information. In particular, methods that rely on external keypoint or motion extractors inherit their failure modes: under severe occlusions, challenging expressions, or large head-pose variations, inaccurate motion estimates can degrade the reenactment. This raises a natural question: can head-avatar reenactment instead operate directly on the visual representations of the reference and driving frames, without specialized identity or motion representations for conditioning ?
paragraphs.zh: 许多现有的头像生成方法都将生成过程建立在特定的身份或动作表示之上，例如隐式关键点（Guo 等人，2024；Li 等人，2026）、3DMM 或姿态/表情参数（Chu 和 Harada，2024），以及通过训练得到的身份或动作表示（Zhao 等人，2025；Xu 等人，2025；Cheng 等人，2025）。这些表示能够提供有效且可控的条件约束。此外，能够抑制外观特征的动作表示会减少驱动信号所携带的身份信息，从而支持跨身份的再演绎。然而，它们也可能丢弃精细的视觉信息。特别是，依赖外部关键点或动作提取器的方法会继承这些提取器的失效模式：在严重遮挡、复杂表情或头部姿态大幅变化时，不准确的动作估计可能会降低再演绎效果。这引出了一个自然的问题：头像再演绎是否可以转而直接基于参考帧和驱动帧的视觉表示进行操作，而无需使用专门的身份或动作表示作为条件约束？

paragraphs.en: Beyond robust conditioning, a second challenge is low-latency continuous generation. Many recent diffusion-based reenactment methods use offline, clip-based generation, jointly processing and denoising a full video clip before producing output Cheng et al. (2025) ; Xu et al. (2025) ; Yin et al. (2025a) ; Guo et al. (2025) . Consequently, the first output frames become available only after denoising the full clip, making low-latency streaming difficult. Longer videos require processing successive clips, often using overlapping or historical frames to maintain continuity. Such clip-wise continuation may suffer from temporal inconsistency and identity drift. Causal autoregressive video diffusion therefore provides a natural basis for incremental streaming generation.
paragraphs.zh: 除了稳健的条件化之外，第二个挑战是低延迟的连续生成。 许多近期的基于扩散的重演方法采用离线、基于剪辑的生成方式，在输出之前联合处理并去噪整个视频剪辑 Cheng et al. (2025) ; Xu et al. (2025) ; Yin et al. (2025a) ; Guo et al. (2025) 。 因此，只有在整个剪辑完成去噪之后，最初的输出帧才能生成，这使得低延迟流式传输变得困难。 更长的视频需要处理连续的剪辑，通常使用重叠或历史帧来保持连贯性。 这种基于剪辑的延续方式可能会出现时间不一致性和身份漂移的问题。 因此，因果自回归视频扩散为增量式流式生成提供了一个自然的基础。

paragraphs.en: Motivated by recent advances in causal autoregressive video generation Huang et al. (2025) ; Liu et al. (2026) ; Samuel et al. (2026) , we start from a compact bidirectional video-diffusion backbone and adapt it to causal generation using the CausVid Yin et al. (2025b) framework, conditioning directly on VAE-encoded reference and driving frames. This yields a streaming model without specialized identity or motion representations. However, this design introduces three challenges. First, under standard self-driving training, direct visual conditioning creates a trivial shortcut: since the reference and driver share the same identity, the model can copy the driver’s appearance rather than learn to separate identity from motion. This motivates cross-identity supervision, for which real paired ground truth is generally unavailable. While pseudo targets from an offline reenactment model provide a practical alternative, they may contain identity, motion, or appearance inaccuracies. Second, autoregressive generation repeatedly conditions on its own previous outputs, allowing small errors to accumulate over long streams and cause temporal inconsistency or identity drift. Finally, stream initialization is challenging when the initial driver pose or expression differs substantially from the reference image, requiring a large motion transition while preserving the reference identity.
paragraphs.zh: 受近期因果自回归视频生成领域进展的启发，Huang 等人（2025）；Liu 等人（2026）；Samuel 等人 （2026）提出了一种方法：我们从紧凑的双向视频扩散模型主干出发，利用 CausVid Yin 等人 （2025b）框架将其适配于因果生成，直接以 VAE 编码的参考帧和驱动帧为条件。 由此得到一种无需专门身份或运动表示的流式生成模型。 然而，这种设计带来了三个挑战。 首先，在标准的自驱动训练下，直接的视觉条件会形成一条简单的捷径：由于参考帧和驱动者共享同一身份，模型可能会直接复制驱动者的外观，而非学习将身份与运动分离。 这促使我们采用跨身份监督，但现实中通常无法获得对应的配对真实数据。 尽管通过离线重演模型生成的伪目标提供了一种实用的替代方案，但它们可能包含身份、运动或外观上的不准确之处。 其次，自回归生成会反复以自身先前输出为条件，导致微小误差在长序列中累积，从而引发时间不一致或身份漂移。 最后，当初始驱动者的姿势或表情与参考图像存在显著差异时，流式生成的初始化便充满挑战：既需要实现大幅度的运动转换，又要保留参考图像中的身份特征。

paragraphs.en: To address these challenges, we introduce PixReenact , a pixel-conditioned streaming head-avatar framework built on causal video diffusion. We train PixReenact in a teacher-student framework with cross-identity pseudo pairs generated offline by Wan-Animate Cheng et al. (2025) , together with real self-driving samples for clean reconstruction supervision. Since pseudo targets may contain identity, motion, or appearance inaccuracies, we mitigate their effect using corrective objectives anchored to the reference and driving inputs. To reduce autoregressive drift, the student is trained on long self-rollouts, using its own generated history as at inference. We treat stream initialization separately using state-aware dual-teacher distillation, with cold-start and steady-state teachers. The resulting model continuously emits frames with low latency while conditioning directly on visual inputs.
paragraphs.zh: 为应对这些挑战，我们提出了 PixReenact——一个基于因果视频扩散的、以像素为条件的流式头显框架。 我们通过师生框架训练 PixReenact，其中伪样本对由 Wan-Animate Cheng 等人（2025）离线生成，并跨越不同身份。 此外，我们还使用了真实的自动驾驶样本，以实现干净的重建监督。 由于伪目标可能包含身份、动作或外观方面的不准确之处，我们借助锚定在参考输入和驱动输入上的修正目标来减轻其影响。 为减少自回归漂移，我们在长序列自展开数据上训练学生模型，并在推理时使用其自身生成的历史数据。 我们通过状态感知双教师蒸馏法单独处理流初始化问题，其中包含冷启动和稳态两种教师模型。 最终模型能够以低延迟持续输出帧，并直接以视觉输入为条件进行生成。

sents.zh: 通过采用 4-NFE 滚动去噪调度方案，PixReenact 每次更新可连续输出四帧，平均输出延迟为 239 毫秒。

sents.en: Our main contributions are:
sents.zh: 我们的主要贡献包括：

paragraphs.en: We introduce a pixel-driven streaming reenactment framework that conditions directly on VAE-encoded reference and driving frames, without specialized identity or motion representations for conditioning.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了一种以像素为驱动的流式重演框架，该框架直接以 VAE 编码的参考帧和驱动帧为条件，无需专门的身份或运动表示作为条件输入。

paragraphs.en: We develop a training strategy for robust cross-identity streaming , combining cross-identity pseudo supervision, corrective objectives, and long self-rollouts to mitigate driver-appearance leakage and long-term autoregressive drift.
paragraphs.zh: 我们开发了一种用于鲁棒跨身份流式处理的训练策略，该策略结合了跨身份伪监督、修正性目标以及长自展开机制，以缓解驾驶员外观泄露和长期自回归漂移问题。

paragraphs.en: We propose state-aware dual-teacher distillation, using separate cold-start and steady-state teachers to distill a 4-NFE causal student for low-latency continuous generation.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了一种状态感知双教师蒸馏方法，通过分别使用冷启动教师和稳态教师来蒸馏一个 4-NFE 因果学生模型，以实现低延迟的连续生成。

paragraphs.en: An alternative retains richer driving-pixel information. MegActor Yang et al. (2024) explores raw-video-driven portrait animation and identifies identity leakage as a key challenge of direct visual conditioning. Unlike PixReenact, it uses an image-diffusion backbone with temporal modules, whereas we use a native video-diffusion backbone adapted for causal generation. X-Portrait Xie et al. (2024) likewise learns motion control from driving RGB and reduces appearance leakage through cross-identity augmentation that modifies the conditioning signal. In contrast, our conditioning remains entirely real, and only the supervision target is synthesized, preserving the same real-driving interface used at inference. Concurrent Wan-Animate-2 Wang et al. (2026) similarly uses direct visual conditioning and Wan-Animate-generated cross-identity supervision, whose Lite variant supports autoregressive streaming. Unlike Wan-Animate-2 Lite, PixReenact combines pseudo supervision with reference- and driver-anchored corrective losses during student training, uses separate cold-start and steady-state score teachers, and emits four-frame rather than eight-frame updates.

paragraphs.en: Many recent diffusion-based portrait animation methods target offline generation rather than causal streaming. FlashPortrait Tu et al. (2026) supports long, potentially unbounded animation through overlapping sliding-window generation and accelerates window-wise denoising by up to 6 × 6\times , but remains offline and relies on extracted facial-expression features. PersonaLive Li et al. (2026) introduces autoregressive micro-chunk generation for low-latency long-term streaming, with sliding training and historical keyframes, while retaining specialized facial-motion and implicit-keypoint conditioning. PortraitDirector Ji et al. (2026) supports real-time streaming through diffusion distillation and causal attention, but conditions on decomposed pose, local facial-motion, and emotion representations. In contrast, PixReenact combines low-latency causal streaming with direct visual conditioning rather than specialized identity or motion representations.
paragraphs.zh: 许多近期的基于扩散的肖像动画方法都针对离线生成，而非因果流式处理。FlashPortrait Tu 等人 （2026）通过重叠滑动窗口生成支持长时段、甚至可能无界的动画，并将窗口级去噪速度提升了高达 6 × 6\times，但仍属离线方法，且依赖提取的面部表情特征。PersonaLive Li 等人 （2026）引入了自回归式微片段生成，以实现低延迟的长期流式处理，并采用滑动训练和历史关键帧，同时保留了专门的面部运动与隐式关键点条件约束。 PortraitDirector Ji 等人 （2026）通过扩散蒸馏和因果注意力支持实时流式处理，但其条件约束基于分解后的姿态、局部面部运动和情绪表示。 相比之下，PixReenact 将低延迟的因果流式处理与直接的视觉条件约束相结合，而非依赖专门的身份或运动表示。

paragraphs.en: Beyond portrait animation, recent causal video-diffusion works Yin et al. (2025b) ; Huang et al. (2025) ; Liu et al. (2026) ; Zhu et al. (2026) show that video diffusion models can be adapted and distilled into few-step autoregressive generators for low-latency streaming. These works establish causal autoregressive video diffusion as a practical approach for streaming, but do not address pixel-conditioned cross-identity reenactment challenges, including driver-appearance leakage, imperfect cross-identity supervision, and large reference-to-driver transitions at stream initialization. PixReenact builds on this paradigm with training mechanisms tailored to these challenges.
paragraphs.zh: 除了肖像动画之外，近期的因果视频扩散研究（Yin et al. (2025b)；Huang et al. (2025)；Liu et al. (2026)；Zhu et al. (2026)）表明，视频扩散模型可以被调整并蒸馏为少步自回归生成器，以实现低延迟流式传输。这些研究确立了因果自回归视频扩散作为流式传输的一种实用方法，但并未解决像素条件化的跨身份重演挑战，包括驾驶员外观泄漏、不完善的跨身份监督，以及流式传输初始化时参考图像与驾驶员之间的巨大转换问题。PixReenact 在这一范式基础上，针对上述挑战设计了专门的训练机制。

paragraphs.en: Head avatar reenactment animates a reference image I ref I_{\mathrm{ref}} using the facial expression, head pose, and motion of a driving video D 1 : T D_{1:T} . We consider the challenging setting of streaming head-avatar reenactment , where driving frames arrive sequentially and the model must continuously generate Y 1 : T Y_{1:T} , preserving the reference identity while transferring the driver’s motion with low latency. Unlike methods relying on specialized conditioning representations such as keypoints or learned motion codes that may discard fine-grained visual cues, PixReenact conditions directly on VAE-encoded reference and driving frames. Avoiding such bottlenecks is important in streaming, since lost information cannot be recovered and errors may propagate through the autoregressive context.
paragraphs.zh: 头部虚拟形象重演通过参考图像 I ref I_{\mathrm{ref}}，利用驱动视频 D 1 : T D_{1:T} 中的面部表情、头部姿态和动作来实现动画化。 我们考虑了具有挑战性的流式头部虚拟形象重演场景：驱动帧依次到达，模型必须持续生成 Y 1 : T Y_{1:T}，在保持参考身份的同时以低延迟传递驱动者的动作。 与依赖关键点或学习到的运动编码等专用条件表示的方法不同（这些方法可能会丢弃精细的视觉线索），PixReenact 直接对经 VAE 编码的参考帧和驱动帧进行条件约束。 在流式处理中，避免此类瓶颈至关重要，因为丢失的信息无法恢复，且错误可能会通过自回归上下文传播。

paragraphs.en: Direct visual conditioning introduces challenges for cross-identity reenactment and autoregressive streaming. We therefore combine cross-identity supervision with corrective objectives to reduce appearance leakage, train on long self-rollouts to reduce autoregressive drift, and treat stream initialization separately from steady-state generation. At inference, a causal rolling denoising process continuously incorporates new driving frames and emits new video frames with low latency.
paragraphs.zh: 直接视觉条件化给跨身份重演和自回归流式处理带来了挑战。 因此，我们将跨身份监督与纠正目标相结合，以减少外观泄露；通过长序列自我展开进行训练，以减轻自回归漂移；并将流初始化与稳态生成分开处理。 在推理阶段，因果滚动去噪过程会持续融入新的驱动帧，并以低延迟输出新的视频帧。

paragraphs.en: A natural route to streaming reenactment is adapting a diffusion-based reenactment model for causal generation. However, such models typically target high-quality offline generation and are not naturally suited to low-latency streaming Li et al. (2026) ; Tu et al. (2026) . We instead convert a compact bidirectional video-diffusion backbone into a causal autoregressive generator using the framework of Yin et al. (2025b) . This yields an efficient streaming backbone, but not yet a reenactment model.

paragraphs.en: Stage 1: State-aware dense teachers. We apply the causal attention masks of Sec. 3.2 to the bidirectional backbone and train self-attention LoRA over a dense range of noise levels using cross-identity supervision. The first streaming emission differs substantially from later ones. At k = 1 k=1 , no generated history is available, so 𝐳 ctx \mathbf{z}^{\mathrm{ctx}} contains only reference-initialized latents. This creates a challenging cold-start state, especially when reference and driver have a large pose gap: the model must establish the driver’s pose while preserving the reference identity. For k > 1 k>1 , the context contains generated history already better aligned with the current driver state, so the model mainly follows incremental motion while maintaining temporal consistency and identity.
paragraphs.zh: 阶段 1：状态感知密集教师模型。 我们将第 3.2 节的因果注意力掩码应用于双向主干网络，并通过交叉身份监督，在密集的噪声水平范围内训练自注意力 LoRA。 首次流式输出与后续输出存在显著差异。 当 k = 1 时，尚无生成的历史数据，因此 𝐳 ctx \mathbf{z}^{\mathrm{ctx}} 仅包含参考初始化后的潜在变量。 这会产生一个具有挑战性的冷启动状态，尤其是在参考与驱动姿态存在较大差异时：模型必须在保持参考身份的同时建立驱动的姿势。 对于 k > 1 的情况，上下文已包含与当前驱动状态更匹配的历史生成数据，因此模型主要遵循增量运动，同时保持时间一致性和身份特征。

paragraphs.en: Evaluation benchmarks. We evaluate PixReenact on three cross-identity protocols and one long-horizon streaming benchmark. First, we introduce a 68-pair extreme-condition benchmark with CelebV-HQ drivers Zhu et al. (2022) and FFHQ references, targeting large viewpoint changes and challenging occlusions. We also evaluate on two standard benchmarks. Following LivePortrait Guo et al. (2024) , we use 25 TalkingHead-1KH test clips Wang et al. (2021) still available on YouTube (out of 35 used in Guo et al. (2024) ) and 50 VFHQ Xie et al. (2022) test clips as drivers, paired with the first 50 FFHQ images Karras et al. (2019) as references. We also construct a 70-pair benchmark from 15 held-out NeRSemble subjects Kirschstein et al. (2023) , with five providing references and all 15 serving as drivers. For long-horizon streaming, we evaluate identity stability on 28 cross-identity videos over five minutes (details in Appendix A.9 ). We additionally report self-reenactment and single-window cross-reenactment results in the Appendix (Tables 10 , 11 , and 12 ).

paragraphs.en: Implementation details. PixReenact uses Wan2.1-T2V-1.3B Team et al. (2025) as its bidirectional video-diffusion backbone and adopts the causal generation and DMD distillation framework of CausVid Yin et al. (2025b) . We apply causal attention masks and use a 4-NFE rolling denoising schedule with timesteps [ 1000,750,500,250 , 0 ] [1000,750,500,250,0] , adapting the DiT with self-attention LoRA. All experiments use 512 2 512^{2} resolution, with runtime measurements on a single NVIDIA H200 GPU. Additional training hyperparameters and implementation details are provided in the Appendix A .
paragraphs.zh: 实现细节。PixReenact 使用 Wan2.1-T2V-1.3B Team et al. (2025) 作为其双向视频扩散模型主干，并采用 CausVid Yin et al. (2025b) 中的因果生成和 DMD 蒸馏框架。我们应用了因果注意力掩码，并使用 4-NFE 滚动去噪调度，时间步长为 [1000,750,500,250,0]，通过自注意力 LoRA 对 DiT 进行了适配。所有实验均使用 512×512 分辨率，并在单块 NVIDIA H200 GPU 上测量运行时间。额外的训练超参数和实现细节见附录 A。

paragraphs.en: We next evaluate PixReenact on the public and NeRSemble cross-identity benchmarks. Figure 4 shows qualitative results. PixReenact preserves reference identity while following the driver’s facial motion, including pronounced expressions. Additional comparisons against all baselines are shown in Appendix Figure 5 . Table 2 compares image-based, offline video-based, and streaming methods. On the public benchmark, PixReenact achieves the best FVD (377.1) and better identity preservation than PersonaLive (ID 0.709 0.709 vs. 0.662 0.662 ), with comparable AED ( 0.790 0.790 vs. 0.788 0.788 ). PersonaLive performs better in APD and tLP. On NeRSemble, PixReenact improves over PersonaLive in ID ( 0.753 0.753 vs. 0.734 0.734 ), AED ( 0.714 0.714 vs. 0.824 0.824 ), tLP ( 0.803 0.803 vs. 0.890 0.890 ), and FVD ( 264.8 264.8 vs. 310.0 310.0 ), while remaining close in APD ( 0.0426 0.0426 vs. 0.0392 0.0392 ). Overall, PixReenact remains competitive with offline methods while streaming continuously without specialized extractors at inference.

paragraphs.en: Cross-identity learning and corrective objectives. paragraphs.en: We introduce PixReenact , a pixel-conditioned framework for low-latency streaming head-avatar reenactment. Across three cross-identity benchmarks and a long-horizon streaming benchmark, PixReenact demonstrates robust cross-identity reenactment under extreme viewpoints, occlusions, and pronounced facial expressions, while maintaining reference identity over five-minute streams. Its 4-NFE rolling formulation continuously emits four frames at 239 ms mean latency.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出 PixReenact，这是一个以像素为条件的框架，用于低延迟的流式头部虚拟形象重演。 在三项跨身份基准测试和一项长时间流式基准测试中，PixReenact 展现了在极端视角、遮挡和明显面部表情条件下稳健的跨身份重演能力，同时在持续五分钟的流式传输中保持参考身份的一致性。 其 4-NFE 滚动公式能够连续输出四帧画面，平均延迟为 239 毫秒。

sents.en: We introduce PixReenact , a pixel-conditioned framework for low-latency streaming head-avatar reenactment.
sents.zh: 我们提出 PixReenact，这是一个以像素为条件的框架，用于低延迟的流式头部虚拟形象重演。

sents.en: Across three cross-identity benchmarks and a long-horizon streaming benchmark, PixReenact demonstrates robust cross-identity reenactment under extreme viewpoints, occlusions, and pronounced facial expressions, while maintaining reference identity over five-minute streams.
sents.zh: 在三项跨身份基准测试和一项长时间流式基准测试中，PixReenact 展现了在极端视角、遮挡和明显面部表情条件下稳健的跨身份重演能力，同时在持续五分钟的流式传输中保持参考身份的一致性。

sents.zh: 其 4-NFE 滚动公式能够连续输出四帧画面，平均延迟为 239 毫秒。

paragraphs.en: Challenges remain. Extreme viewpoints and severe occlusions still challenge streaming reenactment, leaving room to improve motion fidelity and visual quality. Cross-identity training uses costly pseudo targets from an offline model, whose errors leave supervision imperfect despite corrective objectives. Reducing this reliance is important future work. More broadly, our results support direct visual conditioning with causal video generation for robust, low-latency streaming head avatars.
paragraphs.zh: 挑战依然存在。 极端的视角和严重的遮挡仍然对流式重演构成挑战，因此仍有提升动作真实性和视觉质量的余地。 跨身份训练使用来自离线模型的高成本伪目标，而这些模型本身的错误会导致监督机制并不完善，尽管存在纠正目标。 减少这种依赖是重要的未来工作。 更广泛地说，我们的研究结果支持将因果视频生成与直接视觉条件结合，以构建稳健且低延迟的流式头部虚拟形象。

paragraphs.en: Each cross-identity training example pairs a reference image with a 4-second, 512 2 512^{2} driver clip of a different identity. For NeRSemble Kirschstein et al. (2023) , VFHQ training set Xie et al. (2022) , and DH-FaceVid-1K Di et al. (2025) , references and drivers are drawn from the corresponding training source. For FFHQ, we evenly sample 800 references from indices 00050-69999 and pair each with three drivers, yielding 2,400 candidate pairs before filtering. The pseudo target is generated offline by Wan-Animate Cheng et al. (2025) (20 denoising steps) at 512 2 512^{2} . The PL-labels variant instead generates targets with PersonaLive Li et al. (2026) in its streaming mode on the same pairings.
paragraphs.zh: 每个跨身份训练示例都将一张参考图像与一个时长为4秒、分辨率为512×512²的不同身份的驱动片段进行配对。对于NeRSemble（Kirschstein等人，2023）、VFHQ训练集（Xie等人，2022）以及DH-FaceVid-1K（Di等人，2025），参考图像和驱动片段均从相应的训练数据源中选取。对于FFHQ，我们从索引00050至69999中均匀采样800张参考图像，并将每张参考图像与三个驱动片段配对，在过滤前得到2400个候选对。伪目标由Wan-Animate（Cheng等人，2025）以离线方式生成（20次去噪步骤），分辨率为512×512²。而PL-labels变体则使用PersonaLive（Li等人，2026）在流式模式下为相同的配对生成目标。

paragraphs.en: Pseudo targets are filtered for label quality using identity, motion, and emotion consistency criteria: expression and pose agreement with the driver (AED ≤ 0.25 \leq 0.25 , APD ≤ 0.18 \leq 0.18 ), emotion agreement (EmoSim ≥ 0.7 \geq 0.7 ), and an identity-routing margin ID ⁡ ( Y ~ , I ref ) − ID ⁡ ( Y ~ , D ) ≥ 0 \mathrm{ID}(\tilde{Y},I_{\mathrm{ref}})-\mathrm{ID}(\tilde{Y},D)\geq 0 that rejects pseudo targets that copied the driver’s identity. We never filter on absolute identity similarity alone, which would remove mainly hard pairs in which the reference image and driver pose differ. PL labels exhibit a stronger driver-copy failure mode, so their thresholds are stricter on emotion (EmoSim ≥ 0.84 \geq 0.84 ) and margin ( ≥ 0.1 \geq 0.1 ), while the AED/APD thresholds are identical. Table 4 reports per-dataset counts. Filtering metrics are computed with the training-time estimators (Sec. A.6 ): DECA expression (50-D) and head-rotation ℓ 1 \ell_{1} for AED/APD, EmoNet feature cosine for EmoSim, and ArcFace cosine for the identity terms, each evaluated per frame on FAN face crops Wang et al. (2017) and averaged over the clip (full-frame resize when the detector misses a frame). If no face is detected in the pseudo target at all, its identity terms are undefined and the pair fails the margin gate, i.e., it is discarded.
paragraphs.zh: 伪目标通过身份、动作和情感一致性标准进行标签质量过滤：与驾驶员的表情和姿态匹配度（AED ≤ 0.25 \leq 0.25，APD ≤ 0.18 \leq 0.18）、情感匹配度（EmoSim ≥ 0.7 \geq 0.7），以及一个身份路由余量 ID⁡(Ỹ, I_ref) − ID⁡(Ỹ, D) ≥ 0，该余量用于拒绝复制了驾驶员身份的伪目标。我们绝不会仅基于绝对的身份相似度进行过滤，因为这会主要排除参考图像与驾驶员姿态存在差异的困难样本对。PL 标签表现出更严重的驾驶员身份复制失败模式，因此其情感（EmoSim ≥ 0.84 \geq 0.84）和余量（≥ 0.1 \geq 0.1）的阈值更为严格，而 AED/APD 的阈值则保持一致。表 4 报告了各数据集的样本数量。过滤指标是使用训练时的估计器（第 A.6 节）计算的：DECA 表情（50-D）和头部旋转的 ℓ₁ 范数用于计算 AED/APD；EmoNet 特征余弦用于 EmoSim；ArcFace 余弦用于身份相关项。这些指标均在每帧的 FAN 面部裁剪图像上（Wang et al. (2017)）进行评估，并在整个片段中取平均值（当检测器错过一帧时，使用全帧进行缩放）。如果伪目标中完全未检测到人脸，则其身份相关项无定义，该样本对将不通过余量门限，即被丢弃。

paragraphs.en: We use Wan2.1-T2V-1.3B Team et al. (2025) as the bidirectional video-diffusion backbone (30 transformer blocks, hidden dimension 1,536) and adopt CausVid’s Yin et al. (2025b) causal generation framework. The model uses the Wan-VAE ( 8 × 8\times spatial, 4 × 4\times temporal compression; one latent spans four frames), and all experiments run at 512 2 512^{2} . The pretrained backbone weights and VAE are frozen. We train LoRA adapters (rank 64, α = 64 \alpha=64 ) in the self-attention projections of all 30 blocks, together with the conditioning interface. Conditioning follows Sec. 3.2 : one identity latent, window-aligned driving latents, and two context latents, with the restricted attention mask described there (driving window w = 1 w{=}1 ). Text prompts are not used.
paragraphs.zh: 我们使用 Wan2.1-T2V-1.3B Team 等人（2025）提出的双向视频扩散模型作为主干网络（包含 30 个 Transformer 块，隐藏维度为 1,536），并采用 CausVid 中 Yin 等人（2025b）提出的因果生成框架。该模型使用 Wan-VAE（空间压缩比为 8 × 8，时间压缩比为 4 × 4；一个潜在变量覆盖四帧），所有实验均在 512² 分辨率下运行。预训练的主干网络权重和 VAE 被冻结。我们在全部 30 个块的自注意力投影层中训练 LoRA 适配器（秩为 64，α = 64），同时也对条件接口进行了训练。条件输入遵循第 3.2 节的设定：一个恒等潜在变量、与窗口对齐的驱动潜在变量以及两个上下文潜在变量，并采用其中描述的受限注意力掩码（驱动窗口 w = 1）。实验未使用文本提示。

Each forward pass admits one fresh noise latent at t = 1000 t{=}1000 (seed 42 42 ), then advances all in-flight latents by one level, and emits the t = 250 t{=}250 latent to t = 0 t{=}0 (four frames). paragraphs.en: We train rank- 64 64 LoRA adapters on the pretrained bidirectional Wan2.1-T2V-1.3B backbone under the causal attention mask, using the deployed rolling geometry (6-latent windows: 2 context + 4 video latents). The adapters are trained for 27,500 steps from initialization (lr 2 × 10 − 4 2\times 10^{-4} ), followed by 10,000 adaptation steps (lr 10 − 4 10^{-4} ) on the filtered pseudo-pairs with 10% self-driving mixing. Batch size is 4 4 per GPU on 4 4 NVIDIA H200 GPUs. Noise states mix 60% staircase-patterned windows ( t = [ 0 , 0 , 250 , 500 , 750 , 1000 ] t=[0,0,250,500,750,1000] ) and 40% dense timesteps t ∼ 𝒰 ⁡ ( 0.02 , 1.0 ) t\sim\mathcal{U}(0.02,1.0) , so the teacher covers both inference-like mixed-noise states and arbitrary re-noise levels queried during distillation. Both teachers retain the backbone’s native flow-velocity parameterization but are supervised with MSE on the implied clean-latent estimate z ^ 0 = z t − σ t ​ v ^ t \hat{z}^{0}=z^{t}-\sigma_{t}\hat{v}^{t} against the clean target z 0 z^{0} .
paragraphs.zh: 我们在因果注意力掩码下，使用已部署的滚动几何结构（6个潜在窗口：2个上下文 + 4个视频潜在变量），在预训练的双向 Wan2.1-T2V-1.3B 主干网络上训练了秩为 64 的 LoRA 适配器。 适配器从初始化开始训练 27,500 步（学习率 2 × 10⁻⁴），随后在过滤后的伪数据对上继续训练 10,000 步适应阶段（学习率 10⁻⁴），并加入 10% 的自驱动混合。 每块 GPU 的批量大小为 4，共使用 4 块 NVIDIA H200 GPU。 噪声状态由 60% 的阶梯模式窗口（t = [0, 0, 250, 500, 750, 1000]）和 40% 的密集时间步长 t ∼ 𝒰(0.02, 1.0) 混合而成，因此教师模型既覆盖了类推理的混合噪声状态，也覆盖了蒸馏过程中查询的任意重噪声水平。 两个教师模型均保留了主干网络的原生流速度参数化方式，但通过 MSE 对隐含的干净潜在估计值 z⁰ = zᵗ − σₜv̂ᵗ 与干净目标 z⁰ 之间的差异进行监督。

paragraphs.en: The student is trained through long self-rollouts spanning the full 4-second driver clip (30 latents, 120 frames), giving ≈ \approx 28 consecutive emissions from a single cold start. Rollouts are always opened from the deployment cold-start state (reference-initialized context). Losses are applied to emitted latents only. For DMD, the emitted latent is re-noised to t ∼ 𝒰 ⁡ ( 0.02 , 0.98 ) t\sim\mathcal{U}(0.02,0.98) with high-noise emphasis ( t ≥ 0.6 t\geq 0.6 for steady-state emissions; t ≥ 0.8 t\geq 0.8 with probability of 85 % 85\% for the first emission). The real score is the cold-start teacher at the first emission and the steady-state teacher afterwards. The DMD term is scaled × 3 \times 3 on first-emission states. The online fake-score critic is initialized from the same checkpoint as the student and updated three times per generator update. The released model is obtained by successive DMD stages: an initial 30,000-update distillation from the dense teacher followed by shorter refinement stages of the same objective family. The final wan-labels stage (1,000 updates) uses exactly the configuration reported here.

paragraphs.en: We train using the Adam optimizer with β 1 = 0 \beta_{1}{=}0 , β 2 = 0.999 \beta_{2}{=}0.999 , and weight decay of 10 − 4 10^{-4} . The generator and critic learning rates are 10 − 5 10^{-5} and the discriminator uses AdamW with learning rate 10 − 4 10^{-4} . All learning rates are constant, with no warm-up or decay schedule and no gradient accumulation. The critic takes three updates per generator update, and the discriminator takes one update per generator step on which the adversarial loss is active (real self-driving steps). No global training seed is fixed, while all inference and evaluation use seed 42. paragraphs.en: To evaluate identity stability over long streams, we construct a benchmark of 28 continuous 5-minute cross-identity clips. The drivers comprise 10 long-form Barack Obama videos collected from YouTube, 15 videos from the WDA subset of HDTF Zhang et al. (2021) , and 3 long clips extracted from the raw TalkingHead-1KH validation videos Wang et al. (2021) . Each driver is paired with a fixed FFHQ reference image, following the reference order of the public cross-reenactment benchmark, with driver and reference identities always different. Each method processes the full 5-minute sequence continuously, without resetting its temporal state. We measure AdaFace similarity to the reference throughout the stream and aggregate the results over five one-minute intervals. For each clip, scores are first averaged within each minute and then averaged across clips.
paragraphs.zh: 为了评估身份在长时间流中的稳定性，我们构建了一个包含 28 段连续 5 分钟跨身份剪辑的基准数据集。这些驱动者包括从 YouTube 收集的 10 段长版巴拉克·奥巴马视频、来自 HDTF Zhang et al. (2021) 子集 WDA 的 15 段视频，以及从 TalkingHead-1KH 原始验证视频 Wang et al. (2021) 中提取的 3 段长剪辑。每个驱动者都与一张固定的 FFHQ 参考图像配对，遵循公开跨重演基准的参考顺序，且驱动者与参考者的身份始终不同。每种方法都会连续处理完整的 5 分钟序列，而不会重置其时间状态。我们在整个流中测量 AdaFace 与参考图像之间的相似度，并将结果在五个一分钟的时间间隔内进行汇总。对于每个剪辑，首先对每一分钟内的得分进行平均，然后再在所有剪辑上取平均值。

paragraphs.en: All baselines run from their official repositories, released checkpoints, and default configurations, with their own native preprocessing. We list only the deviations required for full-length, frame-aligned evaluation. LivePortrait : official release; per-frame animation with its whole-clip tracking pass; no modifications. Wan-Animate : official 14B release at 20 denoising steps; native 77-frame windows with the repository’s sliding-window continuation for full-length clips. Wan-Animate-2-Base : official release (37 frames per pass); full-length outputs are produced by sequential client-side chunking, as the release provides no long-video continuation. X-NeMo : official release with its native long-video context scheduler (24-frame windows, overlap 4); evaluated in its native crop space against identically cropped references. PersonaLive : official streaming (online) pipeline, unmodified. X-Portrait : official checkpoint; the required per-pair best-frame anchor is selected automatically by matching driver head pose to the reference via FAN landmarks. MegActor- Σ \Sigma : official weights and flags (25 steps, guidance 2); the default 2.5-second generation limit is raised to the full clip length. FlashPortrait : official checkpoint on Wan2.1-I2V-14B with a fixed generic text prompt for all clips; its scheduler requires ≥ \geq 51 latents, so shorter clips cap the context accordingly, and the official output drops the first frame and truncates to 4 ​ k + 1 4k{+}1 frames, which we restore by duplicating ≤ \leq 3 boundary frames. For every method, outputs are fitted to exactly the driver frame count by frame-indexed rewriting when the difference is ≤ \leq 3 frames (float-fps container rounding); larger mismatches abort the sample rather than re-time the video.

paragraphs.en: All methods are scored on the same evaluation clips at 512 2 512^{2} , full length, with outputs frame-aligned to the driver (frame i i of every method corresponds to driver frame i i ). ID / IDD: cosine similarity of AdaFace Kim et al. (2022) (CVLface IR-101, WebFace12M) embeddings between generated frames and the reference image (ID) or the corresponding driver frame (IDD). Faces are detected, aligned and cropped to 112 2 112^{2} , as in the standard AdaFace pipeline. For speed, we do not embed every frame of the clip, but use ∼ 60 {\sim}60 uniformly sampled frames. AED / APD: SMIRK Retsinas et al. (2024) codes on face crops (FAN bounding box, DECA-convention crop, 224 2 224^{2} ) computed for every frame. AED is the ℓ 1 \ell_{1} distance over expression, eyelid, and jaw parameters (55-D) and APD over the 3 head-pose parameters, between generated and driver frames. tLP: Chu et al. (2020) mean over consecutive-frame pairs of | d ⁡ ( Y t , Y t + 1 ) − d ⁡ ( R t , R t + 1 ) | × 100 |d(Y_{t},Y_{t+1})-d(R_{t},R_{t+1})|\times 100 , where d d is LPIPS Zhang et al. (2018) (AlexNet) and R R is the reference sequence (ground truth for self-reenactment, driver for cross). FVD: Unterthiner et al. (2019) set-level with an I3D backbone, where each clip contributes up to eight 16-frame windows (stride 16) spread uniformly over the clip, resized to 224 2 224^{2} . Real statistics come from the ground-truth (self) or driver (cross) clips. PSNR / SSIM / LPIPS / ℓ 1 \ell_{1} : full-frame at 512 2 512^{2} against ground truth, self-reenactment only. X-NeMo Zhao et al. (2025) is evaluated in its native crop space against identically cropped references. Quality tables report the per-clip mean ( ± \pm std where shown), while FVD is a single set-level value.
paragraphs.zh: 所有方法均在相同的评估片段上进行评分，分辨率为 512×512²，且为完整长度；各方法的输出帧与驱动帧对齐（即每种方法第 i 帧均对应驱动帧的第 i 帧）。ID / IDD：计算生成的帧与参考图像（ID）或对应的驱动帧（IDD）之间 AdaFace Kim et al. (2022)（CVLface IR-101、WebFace12M）嵌入向量的余弦相似度。人脸检测、对齐并裁剪至 112×112²，遵循标准的 AdaFace 流程。为提升速度，我们并未对片段中的每一帧进行嵌入，而是使用约 60 个均匀采样的帧。AED / APD：对每一帧的人脸裁剪区域（FAN 边界框、DECA 约定裁剪方式、224×224²）计算 SMIRK Retsinas et al. (2024) 编码。AED 是生成的帧与驱动帧在表情、眼睑和下颌参数（55 维）上的 ℓ₁ 距离，而 APD 则是它们在 3 个头部姿态参数上的 ℓ₁ 距离。tLP：计算 Chu et al. (2020) 提出的连续帧对之间的平均值 |d(Yₜ, Yₜ₊₁) − d(Rₜ, Rₜ₊₁)| × 100，其中 d 为 LPIPS Zhang et al. (2018)（AlexNet），R 为参考序列（自再现时为目标真值，跨模态时为驱动帧）。FVD：采用 Unterthiner et al. (2019) 的集合级评估方法，以 I3D 作为主干网络；每个片段最多贡献八个 16 帧窗口（步长为 16），这些窗口均匀分布在片段中，并调整至 224×224²。真实数据统计数据来自目标真值片段（自再现）或驱动片段（跨模态）。PSNR / SSIM / LPIPS / ℓ₁：在 512×512² 分辨率下，将完整帧与目标真值进行比较，仅适用于自再现场景。X-NeMo Zhao et al. (2025) 在其原生裁剪空间内，与以相同方式裁剪的参考图像进行比较评估。质量表格报告了每个片段的平均值（± 标准差，如适用），而 FVD 则是一个单一的集合级数值。

paragraphs.en: The metrics used in the main paper capture complementary aspects of reenactment quality, but no individual metric fully measures successful cross-identity reenactment. In particular, identity preservation and motion transfer must be considered jointly: reproducing the driver’s face more directly can improve agreement with the driving motion while failing to preserve the reference identity.
paragraphs.zh: 主论文中使用的指标涵盖了重演质量的互补方面，但没有单个指标能够完全衡量成功的跨身份重演。 特别是，身份保留和动作迁移必须共同考虑：更直接地还原驾驶员的面部特征可能会提高与驾驶动作的一致性，但却无法保留参考身份。

paragraphs.en: AED and APD measure distances between expression and pose parameters estimated by SMIRK Retsinas et al. (2024) , rather than distances to ground-truth facial motion. This distinction is especially relevant for our extreme-condition benchmark in Table 1 . SMIRK reports sensitivity to occlusions and shows degraded reconstructions under occlusions and extreme head poses. Consequently, APD and AED estimates may become less reliable precisely on some of the most challenging frames in this benchmark. FVD Unterthiner et al. (2019) also has known limitations as a measure of temporal video quality. Prior work has shown that FVD can be strongly influenced by individual-frame appearance and can be relatively insensitive to temporal corruptions Ge et al. (2024) . Thus, a lower FVD does not necessarily imply better motion transfer or temporal realism in isolation.
paragraphs.zh: AED 和 APD 测量的是 SMIRK 估计的表情和姿态参数之间的距离（Retsinas 等人，2024），而非与真实面部动作之间的距离。 （2024） 这种区别对于我们在表 1 中提出的极端条件基准测试尤为重要。 SMIRK 报告了对遮挡的敏感度，并在存在遮挡和极端头部姿态时显示出重建质量下降的情况。 因此，APD 和 AED 的估计值可能恰恰在本基准测试中最具挑战性的某些帧上变得不那么可靠。FVD（Unterthiner 等人，2019）作为衡量视频时间维度质量的指标也存在已知局限性。 （2019） 先前的研究已经表明，FVD 可能会受到单帧外观的强烈影响，并且对时间维度上的破坏相对不敏感（Ge 等人，2024）。 因此，较低的 FVD 并不必然意味着更好的动作迁移能力或单独的时间维度真实感。

paragraphs.en: Our component ablations provide an additional example specific to cross-identity reenactment. Removing the identity losses, or restricting the driving attention to only the aligned latent, increases driver-identity leakage while improving several motion or distribution metrics (Table 3 ). These improvements do not reflect better cross-identity reenactment: the generated video becomes more similar to the driver at the expense of preserving the reference identity. We therefore interpret ID, AED/APD, tLP, and FVD jointly and complement the quantitative results with qualitative comparisons.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的组件消融分析为跨身份重演任务提供了一个具体的额外示例。 移除身份损失项，或仅将驱动注意力限制在对齐的潜在表示上，会增加驱动方身份的泄露，但同时能改善多项运动或分布指标（表3）。 这些改进并不反映跨身份重演能力的提升：生成的视频与驱动方的相似度更高，但代价是未能保留参考身份的特征。 因此，我们将ID、AED/APD、tLP和FVD进行联合解读，并通过定性比较来补充定量结果。

paragraphs.en: The main paper reports the wan-labels model as PixReenact. To test whether the method depends strongly on the particular model used to construct the cross-identity pseudo targets, Table 9 compares it with an otherwise equivalent model trained using PersonaLive-generated pseudo targets. Neither source consistently dominates across benchmarks or metrics: PL-labels performs slightly better on several motion and temporal metrics, while wan-labels provides stronger identity preservation on the public and NeRSemble benchmarks and lower FVD on the public benchmark. The two models also perform nearly identically on the extreme-condition benchmark. paragraphs.en: Tables 10 and 11 report self-reenactment results on TalkingHead-1KH, VFHQ-Test, and a small 5-sample NeRSemble benchmark, with qualitative comparisons shown in Figure 6 . In this setting, the driving video has the same identity as the reference and therefore provides a strong appearance cue. PixReenact achieves reconstruction quality close to the VAE reconstruction baseline, obtained by directly encoding and decoding the ground-truth video with the frozen Wan-VAE. Importantly, its strong cross-identity performance shows that this does not arise simply from copying the driver: the same model transfers motion from a different identity while preserving the reference appearance.
paragraphs.zh: 表 10 和表 11 报告了 TalkingHead-1KH、VFHQ-Test 以及一个包含 5 个样本的小型 NeRSemble 基准数据集上的自再现结果，定性比较如图 6 所示。 在此设置中，驱动视频与参考视频具有相同的身份，因此提供了强烈的外观线索。 PixReenact 实现了接近 VAE 重建基线的重建质量，该基线是通过使用冻结的 Wan-VAE 直接对真实视频进行编码和解码获得的。 重要的是，其强大的跨身份性能表明，这一结果并非简单地源于对驱动者的复制：同一模型能够从不同身份中迁移运动，同时保留参考视频的外观特征。

paragraphs.en: Table 14 reports three additional sets of controlled experiments. Their protocol differs from the main-paper ablations, where all variants start from the same full-model checkpoint and are continued for 5K steps with one component removed. Here, each group addresses a separate training-design question and therefore uses its own matched setup. Results are directly comparable only within the same group. For the DMD ablation , the variants with and without DMD are initialized from the same dense teacher and trained for 20K steps. For the pseudo-target filtering ablation , the filtered and unfiltered variants start from the same pre-filter checkpoint and are trained for an additional 5K steps, differing only in whether the cross-identity pseudo targets are filtered. Finally, the self-reenactment ablations follow the same continuation protocol as the main-paper ablations: starting from the full model, we continue training for 5K steps after removing either the reconstruction losses or the real self-driving data. The results show that DMD improves temporal consistency and FVD, pseudo-target filtering provides modest gains in identity and motion accuracy, and reconstruction losses and real self-driving samples improve self-reenactment fidelity.
paragraphs.zh: 表 14 报告了另外三组对照实验。 它们的协议与主论文中的消融实验不同：在主论文的实验中，所有变体都从同一个完整模型检查点开始，并在移除一个组件后继续训练 5K 步。 在此，每个小组都针对一个独立的训练设计问题展开研究，因此各自使用匹配的实验设置。 结果仅在相同小组内部具有直接可比性。 对于 DMD 消融实验，包含和不包含 DMD 的变体均从同一个密集教师模型初始化，并训练 20K 步。 对于伪目标过滤消融实验，经过过滤和未经过滤的变体都从同一个预过滤检查点开始，并额外训练 5K 步；二者的唯一区别在于是否对跨身份伪目标进行过滤。 最后，自我重演消融实验遵循与主论文消融实验相同的延续协议：从完整模型出发，在移除重建损失或真实自动驾驶数据后，继续训练 5K 步。 结果表明，DMD 提升了时间一致性和 FVD；伪目标过滤在身份和动作准确性方面带来了适度提升；而重建损失和真实自动驾驶样本则提高了自我重演的保真度。
